description: Builds an absolute path right to left; an absolute segment resets the result. Falls back to `process.cwd()`.
Joins and normalizes segments. Does not make user input safe: `join(root, '../x')` leaves the root.
Using `..` (often encoded as `%2e%2e` or `..%2f`) to reach files outside the intended folder. Guard by resolving, then checking the prefix `root + sep`.
`new URL(input, base)`: the browser-compatible parser, global in Node. Prefer it to the legacy `url.parse()`.
Reads and writes query strings with correct encoding (`url.searchParams.set('q', value)`).
`new URL('users', 'https://x.dev/v1')` replaces `v1`; with a trailing slash (`/v1/`) it appends.
